richiami.difetto: There is a possibility that the M16 Binx nut that fastens the fifth wheel operating handle to the mechanism lever may work loose if it has been reused.  If the bolt becomes detached then the integrity the fifth wheel operational function will be compromised.
richiami.rimedio: Check that the nut bolt and washer is fitted and free to rotate. Replace the nut as required using manufacturers supplied fasteners.
